laws.rule: Machu Picchu tickets are sold only directly to the visitor or registered agencies through the Ministry of Culture's TuBoleto platform or authorised DDC Cusco offices. Tickets are nominal, tied to date, time, circuit and the holder's passport; no name or date changes.
laws.heading: RM 334-2026-MC, art. 15

laws.rule: Enter with your ticket and original passport (foreign visitors); staff may ask for both inside the site. A guide is recommended, not compulsory.
laws.heading: RM 334-2026-MC, art. 17

laws.rule: An unused ticket is void after its date and time; no rescheduling or refunds except proven force majeure.
laws.heading: RM 334-2026-MC, art. 15.5

sources.title: Modifican el Reglamento de uso sostenible y visita turística ... Machupicchu (RM 334-2026-MC)
sources.authority: Diario Oficial El Peruano (Ministry of Culture)

local-law.note: Machu Picchu only. Foreign visitor prices not recorded: the 2026 resolution found covers only national and Andean Community rates.
